issues: Severe volume underestimation (PBIAS=-94.7%) with default uncalibrated parameters — expected, since mHM MPR defaults are tuned for central European basins
Good temporal correlation (r=0.75) suggests timing is reasonable despite magnitude issue
Gauge had to be moved from user-specified location to max-Q L11 cell after first run (routing topology issue)
Forcing tmin/tmax synthesized as tavg±5°C (crude) because CMFD daily only provides mean temperature
PET appears inflated (mean=98 mm/d) — Hargreaves with crude tmin/tmax likely overestimates
ki_gaps: KI FORCING TOOL: convert_forcing_to_mhm.py assumes lat/lon dimension names but CMFD Huai data uses x/y — fails on non-standard CMFD formats
KI FORCING TOOL: does not create header.txt (required by mHM for forcing grid definition)
KI FORCING TOOL: writes yearly NC files but mHM expects a single concatenated NC per variable
KI SOIL TOOL: hwsd_to_mhm_soil.py writes raw MU_GLOBAL IDs (e.g. 14766) into soil_class.asc but mHM requires sequential 1..N class IDs
KI LANDCOVER TOOL: maps AVHRR to 10-class LAI scheme but mHM MPR requires 3-class scheme (forest=1, sealed=2, pervious=3)
KI LATLON TOOL: generates lat/lon at L1 resolution with wrong variable names (lat/lon instead of lat_l0/lon_l0) and wrong dimensions — mHM expects L0+L1+L11 grids in a single file
KI DOMAIN TOOL: computes L1/L11 grid independently from L0 with buffer, but mHM derives L1/L11 as ceil(L0_dims/ratio) — dimensions don't match
KI NAMELIST TOOL: puts resolution in meters (24000) when iFlag_cordinate_sys=1 requires DEGREES (0.25) — despite SKILL.md correctly documenting this
KI NAMELIST TOOL: does not add dir_minTemperature/dir_maxTemperature for Hargreaves PET method
KI GAUGE TOOL: writes simple 4-column format (YYYY MM DD Q) but mHM expects 5-line header + 6-column format (YYYY MM DD HH MM Q)
KI CONFIG TOOL: does not enforce that L2 (forcing) resolution must also be integer multiple of L0 — leads to resolution mismatch errors
MISSING: No tool to handle gauge-to-L11 mapping correction (gauge placement at max-Q cell after first run)
MISSING: No tool to create warmup-year land cover (LCoverYearStart must cover warmup period)
notes: Model binary ran successfully (v5.13.1, 105,192 timesteps, ~1.5s runtime)
All 10 pipeline stages (s0-s8) were attempted using KI tools
7 of 10 KI tools required manual fixes before they produced mHM-compatible output
The KI provides excellent CONCEPTUAL guidance (SKILL.md documents the three-grid architecture, D8 conventions, unit traps) but the TOOLS have bugs that prevent direct use on a new basin
With manual fixes, mHM ran and produced reasonable timing (r=0.75) but poor volume (PBIAS=-95%) — calibration needed
Total basin area in mHM: 17,974 km² (ConfigFile.log) vs expected 30,630 km² — partial coverage at L1 resolution
